newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Elliott hits 155 for Victoria v Northern Territory.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Elliott hits 155 for Victoria v Northern Territory.

text.p: Victoria opening batsman Matthew Elliott on Friday hit a lightning unbeaten 155 to help his side to a total of 277 for two in their limited overs match against a combined Northern Territory XI.
Injured Victoria captain Shane Warne, who this week pulled out of the Australia squad for next month's tour of India, stood down from the match and handed the captaincy to David Saker.
Saker won the toss and elected to bat. Elliott compiled his score, which included 18 boundaries and three sixes, from 154 deliveries.
Elliott's opening partner Graeme Vimpani was Victoria's second highest scorer with 40.
Warne told reporters he would consider playing in Victoria's second match against Northern Territory on Sunday.
